name: Check a member's share balances
description:
Sign on to MERIDIAN CORE as the given operator, look up the member by member number, and open their record. The record shows a table of the member's shares. Read the balance of the FIRST share row shown in the table (i.e. the value cell for that specific row's balance -- not a column header, and not the whole table), and separately read that same first share's status (e.g. whether it is OPEN or on HOLD). These are two separate single-cell reads, each naming one declared output.

Returns: first_share_balance — Balance of the first share row shown on the member record., first_share_status — Status (e.g. OPEN or HOLD) of the first share row shown on the member record.. Possible business outcomes: member_not_found.
